Mission Local asked the District 3 supervisor candidates what they thought about the Granada Hotel, a former senior SRO converted to supportive housing. Their responses differed, but several criticized the city’s rushed acquisition and inadequate oversight. Moe Jamil said the city had concentrated too many shelters and supportive housing facilities in Lower Nob Hill; Sharon Lai said the conversion failed to protect legacy tenants; and Danny Sauter called for better safety, working conditions and accountability. Others described the situation as alarming and said residents deserved better.
